products.name: Munch
products.note: Content repurposing AI; auto-editing; social clips; trend analysis; Israeli vendor

profile_text.body:
Munch is an Israeli AI company operating under the brand Munch Studio, accessible at getmunch.com. The company describes itself as providing done-for-you social media content that is, in its own words, "on-brand, on-time, and hands-free," with an AI engine that generates posts tailored to a custom content strategy built for each business.

The company's core product, also called Munch, falls in the video generation and editing category and is oriented toward content repurposing, auto-editing, social clip creation, and trend analysis. The site frames the service as a hands-free solution for businesses seeking to maintain a consistent social media presence without manual production work.

The held facts note no litigation, no MCP server presence, and no SEC or patent filings on record for Munch at this time.
